title: Every ``str`` a client can supply caps its length
intent: A field is client-supplied when it lives on a table model, on a ``*Create`` / ``*Update`` schema, **or** on any class used as a request body (a route handler's body parameter, or a ``build_crud_router`` create/update schema) -- so an input DTO named off-convention (``LoginRequest``, ``UserProvision``) is capped too, not only the ``*Create`` / ``*Update`` ones. ``str``, ``str | None``, and sequence containers of str (``list[str]``) all count; an uncapped one is an unbounded-input (DoS / abuse) hole.
